education.detail: Intermediate, Board of Secondary Education, Andhra Pradesh, 1975

declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section in the case carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. Only 1 of 17 cases qualifies (IPC 467, forgery of a valuable security, max life, alongside 464/471/474/120B); the rest are defamation, promoting-enmity, public-order, and quarantine-violation sections (153/153A/354A(i)(iv)/500/504/505/506/509/188/269/270/etc.), each under 5yr, or bare SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act citations without a specified serious clause. No cases show 'Charges Framed: Yes'; zero convictions.
